text:
I worked through each service's viewing windows, the 3-service limit, and the already-paid access. The resulting plan misses no (episode, follower) pairs and costs $128.89.

**Why the obvious cheaper shapes fail:**
- **Pebble Kids needs 3 periods.**
  - One period covering 21 Nov – 20 Dec catches both Glass Archive (before 14 Dec) and The Crooked Circuit (Nora, 20–23 Dec).
  - The Distant Orchard needs two more. Nora's 3-day windows run from 16–19 Feb to 23–26 Mar, which one month cannot span.
- **Northline needs 2 periods.**
  - With a single period, it would be on through most of December, the same time Pebble must be on for The Crooked Circuit.
  - Tidewell and Kestrel+ both have Nora episodes every week then, so with the limit of 3 one of her episodes would be missed.
  - Splitting Northline into 20 Nov – 19 Dec and 21 Dec – 20 Jan leaves room for both.
- **Tidewell and Kestrel+ need 3 periods each.** Nora's 3-day windows run continuously over about 74 days, which two one-month periods cannot cover.

**Key timing:**
- Kestrel+ runs 11 Nov – 10 Dec. This catches Copper Archive episode 4 (window 10–13 Dec) on 10 Dec.
- Tidewell starts 11 Dec, the last day of Mara's window for Crooked Kingdom episode 1.
- On 20 Dec Northline is off. Pebble (its last day), Tidewell and a new Kestrel+ period are on, so both Copper Archive episode 5 and The Crooked Circuit are caught.

**Check:** No day has more than 3 services on. No period overlaps another of the same service or the already-paid access.

| Service | Periods | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Tidewell | 3 × $8.99 | $26.97 |
| Kestrel+ | 3 × $17.99 | $53.97 |
| Northline | 2 × $11.99 | $23.98 |
| Pebble Kids | 3 × $7.99 | $23.97 |
| **Total** | | **$128.89** |
